# Method GetExporterOptions

#### GetExporterOptions(int)

Gets the options of an exporter.

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 8, 0, 0)]
List<KeyValue> GetExporterOptions(int inExporterIx)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  int |  inExporterIx |  Index of exporter to analyze, within [0, ExporterCount-1].  |  

##### Returns

|  Type |  Description |  
| --- | --- | 
   
|  List<KeyValue> |  Exporter options.  |  

##### Remarks

This method is available since v7.8.
